scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive classification via an exact-cover recurrence on 15 admissible color-class patterns and an independent full-graph enumeration; no unproved infinite extrapolation. The known five-color minimum is attributed to the prior 2025 paper, and the new claim is the optimal-partition census and automorphism classification.
scientific_limitations: Only the 15-vertex graph S(K_5) is enumerated; historical priority beyond inspected accessible sources and research records remains provisional; independent validation has not occurred.
title: Optimal strong odd coloring census and symmetry of \(S(K_5)\)
